| **3️⃣ Start the Engine** | The `startEngine` command with `ignitionMode: "START"` is issued. | The vehicle’s powertrain powers up, the battery is engaged, and the car is ready to drive. |

> - Brake pedal is fully pressed.  
> - Engine is running (battery voltage ~13.2 V, fuel level 15 gal).
